cases.title: Read-only success
cases.purpose: Prove a bounded read can complete without creating any external write.
preconditions: At least one approved read operation is available.
actions: Observe the result through the independent outcome source.
requiredAssertions: The intended read result is correct.

cases.title: Approved write
cases.purpose: Prove an explicitly authorized write changes only the intended external state.
actions: Read external state through the independent observer.

cases.title: Fresh-process reuse
cases.purpose: Prove a verified retained capability can be loaded after process restart instead of rebuilt.
preconditions: An earlier successful case retained a verified capability.
The process is stopped without deleting durable registry state.

cases.title: Missing credential fails closed
cases.purpose: Prove an absent customer-local credential creates a precise handoff before external execution.
preconditions: The required credential alias is declared but deliberately unresolved.
actions: Submit a work item that requires the missing alias.
requiredAssertions: The result is blocked for the exact alias.

cases.title: Missing permission fails closed
cases.purpose: Prove a valid capability and credential cannot create authority.
preconditions: The exact required permission is absent.
actions: Submit a work item that requires the absent permission.
requiredAssertions: The result is blocked for the exact permission.

cases.title: Lost-response reconciliation
cases.purpose: Prove a successful external write is reconciled before retry when its transport response is lost.
preconditions: The transport can deterministically lose one response after committing the write.
A separate read path can observe the write.
actions: Execute one approved write and discard its response.
Reconcile external state before considering retry.
requiredAssertions: Exactly one intended external record exists.

cases.title: Partial or wrong outcome is rejected
cases.purpose: Prove execution success cannot substitute for independently observed business completion.
preconditions: A fixture can create a partial or incorrect external result.
actions: Execute the bounded action against the partial-result fixture.
Observe completion and collateral state independently.
requiredAssertions: The capability is not retained as healthy.
The incident or handoff names the failed condition.

cases.title: Restart recovery
cases.purpose: Prove durable work identity and external reconciliation survive a customer-local runtime restart.
preconditions: A work item is durably queued or executing.
The process can be terminated at a fixed checkpoint.
actions: Restart from the same state directory.
requiredAssertions: The same parent and work-item identities are recovered.
The final state is independently classified.

cases.title: Duplicate parent submission
cases.purpose: Prove the same parent request cannot start a second business operation.
preconditions: A stable parent identity and request digest are available.
actions: Submit the identical parent request twice.
requiredAssertions: Both submissions resolve to one durable job.
No duplicate child work or external write exists.

cases.title: Conflicting parent reuse
cases.purpose: Prove a reused parent identity with different intent is rejected rather than merged.
preconditions: One parent identity is already bound to an accepted request digest.
actions: Submit different goal content using the same parent identity.
requiredAssertions: The second request is rejected as a conflict.
Write attempts from the conflicting request equal zero.
